title: Retail Inventory Synchronization Pipeline
problem: Manual data reconciliation between on-premises legacy point-of-sale databases and cloud-based inventory management systems causes significant latency and data inconsistencies.
solution: Azure Data Factory orchestrates data movement and transformation through managed pipelines and connectors, automating the extraction of on-premises sales data and loading it into the cloud data lake for centralized processing.
steps: Configure a self-hosted integration runtime to securely connect to the on-premises legacy database.
Define a linked service to establish the connection string and authentication credentials for the source database.
Create a copy activity within a pipeline to move raw sales data from the source to the cloud storage.
Implement a mapping data flow to transform and clean the data before it reaches the final destination.
outcome: Automated, reliable, and timely synchronization of inventory data across all retail locations without manual intervention.
limitation: The self-hosted integration runtime requires a dedicated machine on the local network, which introduces a dependency on local infrastructure uptime and maintenance.
